reason: IIS sends Server: Microsoft-IIS/10.0; webForCore's host is Kestrel.
On IIS (integrated pipeline) Katana's OwinHttpModule ends the request before a managed handler runs, so ASP.NET adds no X-AspNet-Version; webForCore runs the classic pipeline, where it does.
On IIS (integrated pipeline) responses Katana ends in its module get no Cache-Control: private; in webForCore's classic pipeline they do.
An unmatched extensionless URL gets IIS's native 404 page (StaticFile handler); webForCore serves ASP.NET's 404 page. Same status.
IIS's native 404 page is not ASP.NET's, so it has no X-AspNet-Version.
